title: New Jerusalem
definition: The New Jerusalem is the biblical picture of God's redeemed people dwelling with Him in glory, purity, security, and joy.
summary: The New Jerusalem shows the beauty of God's final dwelling with His people, free from sin, curse, darkness, and death.
christFocus: Christ prepares His bride and brings His people into eternal fellowship with God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The New Jerusalem shows the beauty of God's final dwelling with His people, free from sin, curse, darkness, and death.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
